title: Can I take a tour of your Occupational Therapy facility before starting therapy for my child?
metaTitle: Tour Pinnacle Occupational Therapy Facility for Your Child
description: Feel confident in your therapy decisions by taking a tour of our Pinnacle Occupational Therapy facility. Meet our dedicated professionals and see our tailor-made resources for your child's journey.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we not only allow but we wholeheartedly invite parents to tour our facility before you make the decision to start therapy. We understand that as parents, you may have many anxieties and questions regarding the atmosphere, the equipment, and the nature of the therapies provided. By taking a tour, you and your child can become familiar with our therapy environment, which we believe will give you a level of comfort before starting the therapeutic journey with us. Please let our team know when you would like to visit, and we'll do our utmost to accommodate you.
